interpretation: Static dependency labels, not observed failures. Inherited/external routes absent from the snapshot retain uncertainty. Original frozen labels and excluded inventory remain unchanged.

test.py::test_binary_operations.rationale: Uses inherited union/difference operators whose implementations are not in this pinned snapshot; the explicit intersection is defined locally, but the full test has external base-class dispatch.

test.py::test_bitwise_and_consistency.rationale: The custom local __and__ delegates to local intersection; intersection_update filters items directly without pop.

test.py::test_clear.rationale: Calls the locally overridden clear, which resets items and map directly instead of using a base-class pop loop.

test.py::test_comparisons.rationale: Uses inherited strict subset/superset comparison operators; their base-class implementations are outside the pinned source.

test.py::test_empty_pickle.rationale: Invokes external pickle serialization/deserialization for the empty instance; retain uncertainty about external protocol dispatch rather than equating a shared import with a pop dependency.

test.py::test_empty_repr.rationale: Uses the local __repr__ and iteration implementation, neither of which calls pop.

test.py::test_eq_wrong_type.rationale: Local __eq__ rejects the incompatible comparison without invoking pop.

test.py::test_fancy_index_class.rationale: The local fancy-index helper and OrderedSet.__getitem__ read indices and items without pop.

test.py::test_getitem_type_error.rationale: Exercises the local __getitem__ validation and TypeError branch, with no pop call.

test.py::test_indexing.rationale: Local indexing, copy and index paths read/create items and positions; none calls the changed pop method.

test.py::test_operator_consistency_diffe.rationale: Combines locally defined difference methods with inherited subtraction; retain uncertainty about the external operator route.

test.py::test_operator_consistency_disjo.rationale: Calls inherited isdisjoint, absent from the pinned source, alongside local intersection; retain uncertainty about the external base-class route.

test.py::test_operator_consistency_isect.rationale: Local intersection_update, __and__ and intersection use item filtering and _update_items, without pop; helper data generation/comparison is unchanged.

test.py::test_operator_consistency_subse.rationale: Combines local issubset with inherited <= dispatch; the external base-class implementation is not present.

test.py::test_operator_consistency_super.rationale: Combines local issuperset with inherited >= dispatch; the external base-class implementation is not present.

test.py::test_operator_consistency_union.rationale: Combines locally defined update/union methods with inherited union; retain uncertainty about the external operator route.

test.py::test_operator_consistency_xor.rationale: Combines locally defined symmetric-difference methods with an inherited xor operator; retain uncertainty about the external operator route.

test.py::test_order.rationale: Construction, length, local equality and reversed iteration use unchanged methods, without a pop invocation.

test.py::test_ordered_equality.rationale: Local __eq__ compares sequence contents using list/iteration, without pop.

test.py::test_ordered_inequality.rationale: Negation of local equality compares unchanged sequence contents; no pop dependency is expressed.

test.py::test_pandas_compat.rationale: get_loc/get_indexer are local aliases of index, whose unchanged body does not call pop.

test.py::test_pickle.rationale: Invokes external pickle serialization/deserialization and implicit protocol dispatch; no direct pop call is present, but that external behavior is outside this source-only label review.

test.py::test_pop.rationale: Directly invokes OrderedSet.pop twice and passes the bound pop method to pytest.raises; this is a dependency on the edited callable, not evidence of a runtime failure.

test.py::test_remove.rationale: Calls inherited remove, which is not defined in this pinned source; direct discard/index checks alone do not establish the inherited call path.

test.py::test_remove_error.rationale: Calls inherited remove under pytest.raises; the base-class method body is absent from the pinned source.

test.py::test_tuples.rationale: Calls local add, index and __getitem__; these paths do not invoke pop.

test.py::test_unordered_equality.rationale: Local __eq__ compares builtin set values/iteration, not OrderedSet.pop.

test.py::test_unordered_inequality.rationale: The local equality route compares set contents; it does not invoke pop.

test.py::test_update.rationale: Local update loops through add; neither unchanged method calls pop.

test.py::test_update_value_error.rationale: Exercises local update error handling; the changed pop method is not on this path.
